card.name: Space before sodium or dilution amounts
card.fires_on: The space or opening digit just before a number giving a quantity, mostly in sodium content statements (mEq, mg of sodium) or in dilution instructions such as 'diluting 1 mL of 0.1N'.

modes.label: Sodium content amounts
modes.description: The gap or first digit before a sodium amount in mEq or mg.
